title: Mobile Public Homepage
notes: Rebuild the pre-sign-in Northborn homepage mobile-first around real product presentation instead of stacked marketing sections.
Lead with a compact outcome-focused hero and layered desktop/phone product composition that visibly demonstrates Northborn.
Add interactive Manager, Operator and Client product previews so visitors can understand role-specific workspaces directly on the homepage.
Convert the request-to-billing workflow into a touch-friendly horizontal flow on phones.
Convert platform modules and industry chips into mobile horizontal browsing patterns instead of long vertical card walls.
Add an unobtrusive mobile action dock for fast access to Northborn while scrolling.
Strengthen the industrial field-built visual identity and reduce generic SaaS styling.
Maintain production readability with no tiny interface labels in public homepage previews.
